title: Robust Function Calling for LLM Agents Under Interface Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.23342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-augmented language-model agents rely on interface text: tool descriptions, argument schemas, and the candidate tool list shown at inference time. These interfaces often change after deployment even when the underlying tool semantics remain fixed, creating a practical reliability problem for function-calling systems. We study this failure mode as interface drift and evaluate whether a lightweight, training-free repair layer can recover robustness without retraining the base model. Our method, SchemaShield-Lite, combines schema validation, candidate-set retry for missing tool names, and one-shot constrained repair. On Qwen3.5-9B, it raises DICE-300 accuracy from 0.717 to 0.813 and BFCL-200 accuracy from 0.580 to 0.805, recovering 19/22 and 33/45 drift-induced failures with no observed repair harms. translated_title: 接口漂移下LLM智能体的鲁棒函数调用
translated_abstract: 工具增强的语言模型智能体依赖接口文本：工具描述、参数模式（schema）以及推理时展示的候选工具列表。即使底层工具语义保持不变，这些接口在部署后也经常发生变化，这给函数调用系统带来了实际的可靠性问题。我们将这种故障模式称为“接口漂移”并加以研究，评估一个轻量级、无需训练的修复层能否在不重新训练基础模型的情况下恢复鲁棒性。我们的方法 SchemaShield-Lite 结合了模式校验、针对缺失工具名称的候选集重试以及一次性受限修复。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，该方法将 DICE-300 的准确率从 0.717 提升至 0.813，将 BFCL-200 的准确率从 0.580 提升至 0.805，分别恢复了 19/22 和 33/45 个由漂移引起的失败案例，且未观察到修复带来的负面影响。简单的重试机制无法解释这些提升。消融实验表明，候选集漂移（尤其是干扰性工具）是造成大部分观察到的失败的原因……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的轻量级修复层 SchemaShield-Lite，通过模式校验、候选集重试和一次性受限修复，在接口漂移场景下显著恢复LLM智能体的函数调用准确率。
en_tdlr: SchemaShield-Lite, a lightweight training-free repair layer combining schema validation, candidate-set retry, and one-shot constrained repair, substantially recovers LLM agents' function-calling accuracy under interface drift.
